notes: White plaque above the door of the craft shop at the Musée National Boubou-Hama, Niamey; the name is in olive green. The three small header lines are partly faded and only partly legible ('COOPERATIVE ARTISANALE DU MUSEE NATIONAL DE NIAMEY', 'PROJET NIR 935/APPUI AUX ARTISANS', 'DE LA COOPERATIVE DU MUSEE NATIONAL') and are left out; the funder names after 'FINANCÉMENT' are faded. The phone number at the lower right is not certain. The relief lettering over the door ('BOUTIQUE ... ANALE') and the 'COOPERATIVE DU MUSEE NATIONAL' card are distractors. Alternative query: 'Musée National Boubou Hama'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
